cohort: 84 neonates and their placentas, divided into groups with and without HCA
finding: The presence of M2 decidual macrophages was significantly higher in placentas with HCA and was associated with an increased risk of neonatal nCPAP respiratory support, while M1 macrophages were linked to a higher risk of NEC, suggesting a role for decidual macrophage polarization in influencing neonatal outcomes in the context of HCA.
mod_finding: The frequency of vaginal deliveries in HCA + pregnancies was significantly higher than in HCA- pregnancies where deliveries by cesarean section were more frequently observed.
